properties.textContent:
<iframe class="design-video embed-responsive-item card-rounded h-275px w-100"
  src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/BXeqa6qkvUM"
  allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
  allowfullscreen
  id="video1"
  title="Part 1 - Designing a New App"
  style="height: 203px; border: none; border-radius: 0.625rem;">
</iframe>
<div id="designBlock"
   src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/BXeqa6qkvUM"
    style="
      display:none;
      position: absolute; 
      top: 0; 
      left: 0; 
      width: 100%%; 
      height: 100%%; 
      background: transparent; 
      z-index: 2;
    ">
<style>
@media (max-width: 991px) {
    #content main > *:not(.category-label-header, .breadcrumb, .quickEdit){
    	margin-left: 10px !important;
    	margin-right: 10px !important;
    	max-width: 100%% !important;
	}
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .tutorial-video {
        height: 200px !important;
    }
}
@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  #designBlock {
    display: block !important;
  }
  .design-video{
    height: 225px !important;
  }
}
</style>
<script> document.getElementById('designBlock').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const url = this.getAttribute('src');
    // Open URL in a new tab
    window.open(url, '_blank');
  });
</script>
